```sql
WITH rejected_monthly AS (
    -- REJECTED rows per trellise_span
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS trellise_span, COUNT(*) AS ivory_chandler, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS rejected_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM shrine_railcars
    WHERE status = 'REJECTED'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
),
paid_monthly AS (
    -- PAID rows per trellise_span
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS trellise_span, COUNT(*) AS clamp_qty, SUM(claimed_amount) AS paid_total_claimed_amount
    FROM shrine_railcars
    WHERE status = 'PAID'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.trellise_span, b.trellise_span) AS trellise_span,
    COALESCE(a.ivory_chandler, 0) AS ivory_chandler,
    a.rejected_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.clamp_qty, 0) AS clamp_qty,
    COALESCE(b.paid_total_claimed_amount, 0) AS paid_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.ivory_chandler, 0) - COALESCE(b.clamp_qty, 0) AS net_count
FROM rejected_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN paid_monthly b
  ON a.trellise_span = b.trellise_span
ORDER BY trellise_span
```
code:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

rejected_monthly = (
    df_shrine_railcars
    .filter(F.col("status") == "REJECTED")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("trellise_span"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("ivory_chandler"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("rejected_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

paid_monthly = (
    df_shrine_railcars
    .filter(F.col("status") == "PAID")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("trellise_span"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("clamp_qty"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("paid_total_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    rejected_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(paid_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.trellise_span") == F.col("b.trellise_span"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.trellise_span"), F.col("b.trellise_span")).alias("trellise_span"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.ivory_chandler"), F.lit(0)).alias("ivory_chandler"),
        F.col("a.rejected_avg_claimed_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.clamp_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("clamp_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.paid_total_claimed_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("paid_total_claimed_amount"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.ivory_chandler"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.clamp_qty"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("trellise_span")
)
```

```sql
WITH cleaned_outage_events AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        power_plant_id,
        zone_code,
        fuel_type,
        voltage_kv,
        inspected_date,
        CASE WHEN voltage_kv >= 405 THEN 'large' WHEN voltage_kv >= 187 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS voltage_kv_tier,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', inspected_date) AS days_since_inspected_date,
        CONCAT(fuel_type, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS windmill_code
    FROM deltas
    WHERE is_renewable = FALSE
      AND inspected_date < DATE '2025-09-22'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        power_plant_id,
        zone_code,
        voltage_kv,
        inspected_date,
        days_since_inspected_date,
        windmill_code,
        CONCAT(windmill_code, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS fuel_type_ref_ref
    FROM cleaned_outage_events
    WHERE YEAR(inspected_date) = 2025
),
with_children_outage_events AS (
    -- One row per outage_event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.power_plant_id,
        s.zone_code,
        s.inspected_date,
        s.days_since_inspected_date,
        s.fuel_type_ref_ref,
        o.id AS outage_event_id,
        o.zone_code AS outage_event_zone_code,
        o.voltage_kv AS outage_event_voltage_kv,
        o.fuel_type AS outage_event_fuel_type
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN deltas o ON o.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach river_barrels metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(g.fuel_cost_dollars), 2) FROM river_barrels g WHERE g.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id) AS avg_generator_fuel_cost_dollars
    FROM with_children_outage_events s
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach river_barrels metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(g.outage_started_ts) FROM river_barrels g WHERE g.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id) AS last_generator_outage_started_ts,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM river_barrels g WHERE g.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id) AS generator_count,
        (SELECT MAX(g.outage_started_ts) FROM river_barrels g WHERE g.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id) AS last_generator_outage_started_ts_2
    FROM with_stats s
),
outage_event_zone_code_stats AS (
    -- Max outage_event_voltage_kv per outage_event_zone_code
    SELECT outage_event_zone_code, MAX(outage_event_voltage_kv) AS max_outage_event_voltage_kv
    FROM profiled
    GROUP BY outage_event_zone_code
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_outage_event_voltage_kv,
        ROUND(s.outage_event_voltage_kv - g.max_outage_event_voltage_kv, 2) AS outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN outage_event_zone_code_stats g ON g.outage_event_zone_code = s.outage_event_zone_code
    WHERE s.outage_event_voltage_kv = g.max_outage_event_voltage_kv
),
with_stats_2 AS (
    -- Attach deltas metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deltas o WHERE o.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id) AS outage_event_count,
        (SELECT MIN(o.inspected_date) FROM deltas o WHERE o.power_plant_id = s.power_plant_id) AS first_outage_event_inspected_date
    FROM outliers s
),
grouped AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', inspected_date) AS inspected_date_month,
        DATE_FORMAT(first_outage_event_inspected_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS first_outage_event_inspected_date_ym,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outage_event_zone_code IS NOT NULL THEN max_outage_event_voltage_kv ELSE 0 END) AS max_outage_event_voltage_kv_outage_event_zone_co,
        ROUND(AVG(outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max), 2) AS avg_outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(AVG(generator_count), 2) AS avg_generator_count
    FROM with_stats_2
    WHERE max_outage_event_voltage_kv > 182.2
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', inspected_date), DATE_FORMAT(first_outage_event_inspected_date, 'yyyy-MM')
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(n_rows - AVG(n_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows), 2) AS n_rows_vs_n_rows_avg,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows ORDER BY avg_generator_count DESC), 3) AS avg_generator_count_cume_dist,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_n_rows_inspected_date_month, 3) AS avg_generator_count_cume_dist_2,
        ROUND(AVG(n_rows) OVER w_n_rows, 2) AS n_rows_avg_n_rows
    FROM grouped
    WINDOW w_n_rows_inspected_date_month AS (PARTITION BY n_rows, MONTH(inspected_date_month) ORDER BY avg_generator_count DESC), w_n_rows AS (PARTITION BY n_rows)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    inspected_date_month,
    first_outage_event_inspected_date_ym,
    avg_outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max,
    n_rows,
    avg_generator_count,
    avg_generator_count_cume_dist
FROM ranked
ORDER BY first_outage_event_inspected_date_ym DESC NULLS FIRST, inspected_date_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_outage_events = (
    df_deltas
    .filter((~F.col("is_renewable")) & (F.col("inspected_date") < F.lit("2025-09-22").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "power_plant_id",
        "zone_code",
        "fuel_type",
        "voltage_kv",
        "inspected_date",
        F.when(F.col("voltage_kv") >= 405, "large").when(F.col("voltage_kv") >= 187, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("voltage_kv_tier"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("inspected_date")).alias("days_since_inspected_date"),
        F.concat(F.col("fuel_type"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("windmill_code"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned_outage_events
    .filter(F.year(F.col("inspected_date")) == 2025)
    .select(
        "id",
        "power_plant_id",
        "zone_code",
        "voltage_kv",
        "inspected_date",
        "days_since_inspected_date",
        "windmill_code",
        F.concat(F.col("windmill_code"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("fuel_type_ref_ref"),
    )
)

with_children_outage_events = (
    enriched.alias("s")
    .join(df_deltas.alias("o"), F.col("o.power_plant_id") == F.col("s.power_plant_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.power_plant_id",
        "s.zone_code",
        "s.inspected_date",
        "s.days_since_inspected_date",
        "s.fuel_type_ref_ref",
        F.col("o.id").alias("outage_event_id"),
        F.col("o.zone_code").alias("outage_event_zone_code"),
        F.col("o.voltage_kv").alias("outage_event_voltage_kv"),
        F.col("o.fuel_type").alias("outage_event_fuel_type"),
    )
)

generator_stats = (
    df_river_barrels
    .groupBy("power_plant_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("fuel_cost_dollars"), 2).alias("avg_generator_fuel_cost_dollars"),
    )
)

with_stats = (
    with_children_outage_events.alias("s")
    .join(generator_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.power_plant_id") == F.col("s.power_plant_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "g.avg_generator_fuel_cost_dollars")
)

generator_stats_2 = (
    df_river_barrels
    .groupBy("power_plant_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("outage_started_ts").alias("last_generator_outage_started_ts"),
        F.count("*").alias("generator_count"),
        F.max("outage_started_ts").alias("last_generator_outage_started_ts_2"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    with_stats.alias("s")
    .join(generator_stats_2.alias("g"), F.col("g.power_plant_id") == F.col("s.power_plant_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.last_generator_outage_started_ts",
        F.coalesce(F.col("g.generator_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("generator_count"),
        "g.last_generator_outage_started_ts_2",
    )
)

outage_event_zone_code_stats = (
    profiled
    .groupBy("outage_event_zone_code")
    .agg(F.max("outage_event_voltage_kv").alias("max_outage_event_voltage_kv"))
)

outliers = (
    profiled.alias("s")
    .join(outage_event_zone_code_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.outage_event_zone_code") == F.col("s.outage_event_zone_code"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.outage_event_voltage_kv") == F.col("g.max_outage_event_voltage_kv"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_outage_event_voltage_kv",
        F.round(F.col("s.outage_event_voltage_kv") - F.col("g.max_outage_event_voltage_kv"), 2).alias("outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max"),
    )
)

outage_event_stats = (
    df_deltas
    .groupBy("power_plant_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("outage_event_count"),
        F.min("inspected_date").alias("first_outage_event_inspected_date"),
    )
)

with_stats_2 = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(outage_event_stats.alias("o"), F.col("o.power_plant_id") == F.col("s.power_plant_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("o.outage_event_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("outage_event_count"),
        "o.first_outage_event_inspected_date",
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_stats_2
    .filter(F.col("max_outage_event_voltage_kv") > 182.2)
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("month", "inspected_date").alias("inspected_date_month"),
        F.date_format("first_outage_event_inspected_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("first_outage_event_inspected_date_ym"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("outage_event_zone_code").isNotNull(), F.col("max_outage_event_voltage_kv")).otherwise(0)).alias("max_outage_event_voltage_kv_outage_event_zone_co"),
        F.round(F.avg("outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max"), 2).alias("avg_outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("generator_count"), 2).alias("avg_generator_count"),
    )
)

w_n_rows_inspected_date_month = Window.partitionBy("n_rows", F.month("inspected_date_month")).orderBy(F.col("avg_generator_count").desc())
w_n_rows = Window.partitionBy("n_rows")
ranked = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("n_rows") - F.avg("n_rows").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows")), 2).alias("n_rows_vs_n_rows_avg"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows").orderBy(F.col("avg_generator_count").desc())), 3).alias("avg_generator_count_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_n_rows_inspected_date_month), 3).alias("avg_generator_count_cume_dist_2"),
        F.round(F.avg("n_rows").over(w_n_rows), 2).alias("n_rows_avg_n_rows"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "inspected_date_month",
        "first_outage_event_inspected_date_ym",
        "avg_outage_event_voltage_kv_minus_max",
        "n_rows",
        "avg_generator_count",
        "avg_generator_count_cume_dist",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("first_outage_event_inspected_date_ym").desc_nulls_first(),
        "inspected_date_month",
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH filtered_tickets AS (
    -- Filter rural_dories
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        marble_bracelet,

    FROM rural_dories

without_matches AS (

    FROM filtered_tickets
    WHERE csat < (SELECT MAX(csat) FROM filtered_tickets)
),
with_children AS (

    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.marble_bracelet,
        s.channel,
        s.csat,
        s.channel_slug,
        s.channel_ref,
        t.id AS event_id,
        t.event_type,
        t.furnace_rank
    FROM without_matches s
    LEFT JOIN fact_albums t ON t.ticket_id = s.id
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Attach agent attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.marble_bracelet,
        s.channel_slug,
        s.channel_ref,
        s.event_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.furnace_rank,
        su.agent_name,
        su.team AS agent_team,
        su.hired_on AS agent_hired_on,
        t.actor AS event_actor
    FROM with_children s
    JOIN quartz_museums su ON su.id = s.agent_id
    JOIN fact_albums t ON t.id = s.event_id
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, TRUNC(agent_hired_on, 'MM') AS agent_hired_on_month_start
    FROM with_parent
    WHERE agent_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    id,
    agent_id,
    opened_at,
    channel_slug,
    channel_ref,
    event_id,
    event_type,
    furnace_rank,
    agent_team,
    agent_hired_on,
    event_actor,
    agent_hired_on_month_start,
    TRUNC(agent_hired_on, 'MM') AS agent_hired_on_month_start_2,
    COALESCE(agent_team, 'UNKNOWN') AS emitter_note
FROM annotated
ORDER BY agent_id DESC NULLS FIRST, emitter_note
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_tickets = (
    df_rural_dories
    .filter((F.col("channel").isin("email", "web")) & (F.col("opened_at") >= F.lit("2025-01-25 11:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "marble_bracelet",
        "channel",
        "csat",

        F.concat(F.col("channel"), F.lit("#"), F.col("agent_id").cast("string")).alias("channel_ref"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    filtered_tickets
    .crossJoin(filtered_tickets.agg(F.max("csat").alias("overall_max_csat")))
    .filter(F.col("csat") < F.col("overall_max_csat"))
    .drop("overall_max_csat")
)

with_children = (
    without_matches.alias("s")
    .join(df_fact_albums.alias("t"), F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.requester_id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.opened_at",
        "s.marble_bracelet",
        "s.channel",
        "s.csat",
        "s.channel_slug",
        "s.channel_ref",
        F.col("t.id").alias("event_id"),
        "t.event_type",
        "t.furnace_rank",
    )
)

with_parent = (
    with_children.alias("s")
    .join(df_quartz_museums.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_fact_albums.alias("t"), F.col("t.id") == F.col("s.event_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.opened_at",
        "s.marble_bracelet",
        "s.channel_slug",
        "s.channel_ref",
        "s.event_id",
        "s.event_type",
        "s.furnace_rank",
        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.team").alias("agent_team"),
        F.col("su.hired_on").alias("agent_hired_on"),
        F.col("t.actor").alias("event_actor"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    with_parent
    .filter(F.col("agent_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("agent_hired_on_month_start", F.trunc(F.col("agent_hired_on"), "MM"))
)

result = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "channel_slug",
        "channel_ref",
        "event_id",
        "event_type",
        "furnace_rank",
        "agent_team",
        "agent_hired_on",
        "event_actor",
        "agent_hired_on_month_start",
        F.trunc(F.col("agent_hired_on"), "MM").alias("agent_hired_on_month_start_2"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("agent_team"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("emitter_note"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("agent_id").desc_nulls_first(), "emitter_note")
)
```

```sql
WITH bravo_monthly AS (
    -- bravo rows per alpha_bakerie
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', policy_start) AS alpha_bakerie, COUNT(*) AS bravo_count, SUM(risk_score) AS bravo_total_risk_score
    FROM teal_scanners
    WHERE adjuster_team = 'bravo'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', policy_start)
),
alpha_monthly AS (
    -- alpha rows per alpha_bakerie
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', policy_start) AS alpha_bakerie, COUNT(*) AS alpha_count, SUM(risk_score) AS alpha_total_risk_score
    FROM teal_scanners
    WHERE adjuster_team = 'alpha'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', policy_start)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.alpha_bakerie, b.alpha_bakerie) AS alpha_bakerie,
    COALESCE(a.bravo_count, 0) AS bravo_count,
    a.bravo_total_risk_score,
    COALESCE(b.alpha_count, 0) AS alpha_count,
    b.alpha_total_risk_score,
    COALESCE(a.bravo_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.alpha_count, 0) AS dispatche_ref
FROM bravo_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN alpha_monthly b
  ON a.alpha_bakerie = b.alpha_bakerie
ORDER BY alpha_bakerie
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

bravo_monthly = (
    df_teal_scanners
    .filter(F.col("adjuster_team") == "bravo")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "policy_start").alias("alpha_bakerie"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("bravo_count"),
        F.sum("risk_score").alias("bravo_total_risk_score"),
    )

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("alpha_count"),
        F.sum("risk_score").alias("alpha_total_risk_score"),
    )
)

result = (
    bravo_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(alpha_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.alpha_bakerie") == F.col("b.alpha_bakerie"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.alpha_bakerie"), F.col("b.alpha_bakerie")).alias("alpha_bakerie"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.bravo_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("bravo_count"),
        F.col("a.bravo_total_risk_score"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.alpha_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("alpha_count"),
        F.col("b.alpha_total_risk_score"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.bravo_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.alpha_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("dispatche_ref"),
    )
    .orderBy("alpha_bakerie")
)
```

```sql
        kiosk_owner,

        CASE WHEN ochre_clipper IN ('card', 'cash') THEN 'group_a' WHEN ochre_clipper = 'qr' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS brigade_span

        brigade_span,
        SUM(tap_fare_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(visited_ts) ORDER BY tap_fare_distance DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS tap_fare_distance_sum_3,
        ROUND(AVG(quartz_motel) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(visited_ts) ORDER BY tap_fare_distance DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS tap_fare_avg_6_prior,
        NTH_VALUE(quartz_motel, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(visited_ts) ORDER BY tap_fare_distance DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_tap_fare
    FROM prepared_store_kiosks
),
with_details_bus_stop AS (

        s.id,

    FROM sequenced s
    JOIN array_cadets b ON b.id = s.bus_stop_no
),
qualified AS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_store_kiosks = (
    df_scanners
    .filter((F.col("visited_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-19 14:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.upper(F.trim(F.col("kiosk_owner"))).like("M%")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "bus_stop_no",
        "stop_label",
        "quartz_motel",
        "visited_ts",
        "kiosk_owner",
        F.concat(F.col("stop_label"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("stop_label_ref"),
        F.abs(F.col("quartz_motel") - 3.5).alias("tap_fare_distance"),
        F.when(F.col("ochre_clipper").isin("card", "cash"), "group_a").when(F.col("ochre_clipper") == "qr", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("brigade_span"),
    )
)

sequenced = (

    .select(

        "stop_label",

        F.round(F.avg("quartz_motel").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("visited_ts")).orderBy(F.col("tap_fare_distance").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)), 2).alias("tap_fare_avg_6_prior"),
        F.nth_value("quartz_motel", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("visited_ts")).orderBy(F.col("tap_fare_distance").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_tap_fare"),
    )
)

with_details_bus_stop = (
    sequenced.alias("s")
    .join(df_array_cadets.alias("b"), F.col("b.id") == F.col("s.bus_stop_no"), "inner")
    .select(

        "s.quartz_motel",
        "s.visited_ts",
        "s.brigade_span",

        F.col("b.ochre_clipper").alias("bus_stop_tap_media"),

    )
)

qualified = (

)
```
